focus: Distribution: the plugin CLI payload and bin shim, plugin mechanics from the official docs, standalone install, per-platform sharp and pinned ffmpeg, and the dist layout constraint
keyQuestions: How should the plugin and a standalone package expose the CLI to Claude Code and other terminal agents while preserving dist-relative assets?
answeredQuestions: How should the plugin and a standalone package expose the CLI to Claude Code and other terminal agents while preserving dist-relative assets?

label: The plugin build now ships and checks the CLI: build-plugin.ts:363-367 fails when server/dist/cli.js is absent, and 385-393 writes bin/media-editor and bin/media-editor.cmd, with the POSIX shim resolving its own real path through a readlink loop and running node server/dist/cli.js (build-plugin.ts:59-70).

The plugin manifest still carries the MCP route: claude-plugin/.claude-plugin/plugin.json is tracked and unmodified since the rename and its mcpServers block still points at server/dist/index.js with MEDIA_EDITOR_DATA_DIR, so the fixed-decision flip to no MCP server is an open distribution item.

The standalone install is declared, not published: package.json:9-12 lists media-editor-mcp to dist/index.js and media-editor to dist/cli.js while the package is private, so the routes are node dist/cli.js from the package root or a local global install, with no npm publication in scope.

Bundle staging is unchanged so the CLI rides along: build-bundle.ts:76 stages dist, assets and licenses whole and the size limit is 150000000 bytes (bundle/targets.ts:29), while the one new check the design asked for, dist/cli.js presence, now exists in the plugin build.

Official docs, question A: a plugin skill can read CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT only through inline Markdown substitution, since the resolution table says skill command and agent content resolve anywhere in the Markdown body and the variables are not present in the Bash tool environment.

Official docs, question B: a plugin bin folder is on the Bash tool PATH while the plugin is enabled so Claude runs bare commands, and claude.ai and Cowork do not install a plugin with that directory, which is the recorded cost of the bare media-editor route.

The plugin also ships the skill: build-plugin.ts:369-382 copies sk-media-editor into claude-plugin/skills and fails on any difference, and plugin skills load from plugin/skills/skill-name/SKILL.md and are namespaced as /plugin-name:skill-name.

Per-platform sharp and the pinned ffmpeg need no new work: the bundle is built per platform target, test-pinned.ts:83-122 places the pinned pair and verifies each binary against its digest before placement, and the resolver reads the pair from dataDir/bin or the bundled path through the same loadConfig the CLI uses.

The dist layout constraint is two relative reads: server-info.ts:42 loads ../../package.json through createRequire and font-path.ts:51 resolves ../../assets/fonts through import.meta.url, so dist/cli.js adds no directory level and a single-file bundle would break both. The plugin README still describes the MCP delivery and follows the manifest flip.
